Rule.name: FSIEM-LM-001
Rule.Description: Detects NTLM pass-the-hash attacks where an adversary uses a password hash instead of plaintext password

Rule.name: FSIEM-LM-002
Rule.Description: Detects Kerberos ticket reuse across systems indicating pass-the-ticket attacks

Rule.name: FSIEM-LM-003
Rule.Description: Detects anomalous RDP connections including unusual source IPs, off-hours access, or lateral movement patterns

Rule.name: FSIEM-LM-004
Rule.Description: Detects SSH connections from compromised hosts to internal systems indicating lateral movement

Rule.name: FSIEM-LM-005
Rule.Description: Detects remote execution via WMI, PSExec, or similar tools indicating lateral movement

Rule.name: FSIEM-LM-006
Rule.Description: Detects lateral movement through SMB admin shares (C$, ADMIN$) for remote execution

Rule.name: FSIEM-LM-007
Rule.Description: Detects DCOM-based lateral movement through distributed COM object activation

Rule.name: FSIEM-LM-008
Rule.Description: Detects Windows Remote Management shell access for lateral movement and remote execution

Rule.name: FSIEM-LM-009
Rule.Description: Detects Kerberos Golden Ticket attacks where forged TGTs grant persistent domain access

Rule.name: FSIEM-LM-010
Rule.Description: Detects Kerberos Silver Ticket attacks using forged service tickets for targeted service access
